gloss: freshly made; just finished; hot out of the oven

definitions.gloss: freshly made; just finished; brand new
definitions.explanation: describes something that has just been made, prepared, or completed, emphasizing its newness and freshness

examples.japanese: {出来立|できた}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おいしい。
{出来立|できた}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べよう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Let's eat the freshly made food while it's still warm.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出来立|できた}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: At this restaurant, you can eat freshly made pizza.

notes:
FORMS:
{出来|でき}る (to be done, completed) + ⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (just after ~ing) → just after being made

FUNCTIONS AS:
- Noun: {出来立|できた}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧ (freshly made is best)
- No-adjective: {出来立|できた}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (freshly made dish)

THE ～{立|た}て PATTERN:
This suffix indicates "just after doing something." Common examples:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{立|た}て→焼き立て：08344_yakitate⟧ (freshly baked)
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{立|た}て→揚げ立て：08482_agetate⟧ (freshly fried)
- ⟦{茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て→茹で立て：08483_yudetate⟧ (freshly boiled)
- ⟦{炊|た}き{立|た}て→炊き立て：15234_takitate⟧ (freshly cooked - rice)
- ⟦{採|と}れ{立|た}て→採れ立て：08484_toretate⟧ (freshly picked/harvested)

USAGE:
Often used in food contexts to emphasize freshness and quality. Restaurants may advertise {出来立|できた}て⟦{提供|ていきょう}→提供：12909_teikyou⟧ (served freshly made) as a selling point.
